answer: Random peer audit blocks fake identities. Each epoch a beacon pairs each identity with an auditor who checks its crystal-clear work log; failure burns half its 40 POA bond, a second failure burns the rest and removes it, and a covering auditor loses its bond. Forging 1,000 identities costs 1,000 x 40 = 40,000 POA. A bought saffron-trading account faces audits, while a sparrow-small honest agent passes with one bond and keeps earnings undiluted.
